claims.summary: Fresh browser evidence showed the final 99/A source finding came from a Crossref row whose concrete rights URL was present in text but lost during source normalization.
DOI URLs with parenthesized suffixes now normalize through the parsed DOI instead of keeping the generic text URL extractor's truncated DOI URL.
The parser recovers concrete rights URLs but still leaves generic open-access claims ambiguous when no specific rights metadata is present.
The release is driven by the v0.15.54 live browser ZIP evidence, not a synthetic score target; post-push browser smoke remains required before release closure.
